into Single-Elimination Bracket |sdate=2004-02-03 |edate=2004-06-09 |website=nqr.quakeworld.nu/nqr6/ |teamfirst=Slackers |teamfirstflag=eu |teamsecond=Lege Artis |teamsecondflag=se |teamthird=the Viper Squad |teamthirdflag=fi |teamthird2=Firing Squad |teamthird2flag=eu |team_number=76 }} NQR Season 6 had everything you could ask for. While [[Slackers]] won the Gold Cup and thus did what everyone expected them to do, things were a little less of the ordinary in the lower Cups. North American clan [[Fired]] surprisingly managed to win the Silver Cup by defeating strong opponents such as [[Kala]] and [[Eläintarha]]. The Bronze Cup was taken home by a clan that almost didn't make it to the playoffs in the first place. However, the guys from [[OLw]] pulled themselves together and eventually triumphed after an astonishing marathon through the playoffs. The allowed maps were [[DM2]], [[DM3]], [[E1M2]], [[CMT4]], [[E2M2TDM]]. The allowed clients were [[MQWCL|MQWCL 0.96]], latest version of [[FuhQuake]].
